title: assumptions_and_sources.xlsx content contract
description: Describes the required rows of assumptions_and_sources.xlsx: one row per modeling assumption made in producing decision_memo.pdf and financial_model.xlsx, each grounded in a source via a nested provenance envelope.

assumption_id.description: A unique identifier for this assumption row.

assumption_label.description: A short human-readable label naming what this assumption governs.

assumption_value.description: The assumed value or method itself, rendered as text regardless of its underlying type (number, date or string).

unit.description: The unit assumption_value is expressed in (e.g. a currency, a rate convention, or 'n/a' for a non-numeric assumption).

basis.description: The in-corpus document or governing definition this assumption is grounded in.

alternative_method_note.description: Where a defensible alternative method exists, a note explaining why the chosen method was preferred over that alternative. Read by the scorer's alternative-method credit check.

provenance.description: The source this assumption is grounded in.
